text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen has finally arrived,<n>and Mejiro
Dober is overwhelmed by<n>the caliber of the senior
racers she's<n>to compete against.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's when Air Groove appears,<n>exuding her
usual oppressive air, and<n>Mejiro Dober finds
herself nearly<n>suffocated by it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Mejiro Dober refuses to be<n>overwhelmed and
stands her ground!<n>The final race of her classic
year is<n>about to begin!
